components.name: Developer's app
components.description: Customer system that registers endpoints and sends events to Hookd's JSON API with a bearer API key.

components.name: Reverse proxy (nginx / load balancer)
components.description: Production TLS front that forwards requests to one or more hookd instances.

components.name: Webhook receiver
components.description: A registered endpoint URL that receives signed Standard Webhooks POSTs.

components.name: hookd CLI
components.description: Single binary with serve, migrate, account create and apikey create/list/revoke subcommands.

components.name: HTTP API
components.description: Versioned /v1 JSON routes for endpoints, events, secrets and delivery attempts on http.ServeMux, plus /healthz; routes / and /admin to the admin UI when it is on.

components.name: API key auth
components.description: Middleware that hashes the bearer key, resolves the account and scopes every request to it.

components.name: Admin UI
components.description: Server-rendered pages under /admin (HOOKD_ADMIN_UI) for accounts, API keys, endpoints, events with their attempts, and settings; no sign-in, cross-origin protected.

components.name: Built-in test receiver
components.description: POST /admin/test-receiver/{id}: verifies deliveries to admin test endpoints and stores the requests in the database.

components.name: Settings manager
components.description: Effective run-time config: environment plus overrides from the settings table, reloaded every 5 s; owns the log level.

components.name: Input checks
components.description: URL, description, event type, idempotency key and payload checks shared by the API and the admin UI.

components.name: Delivery workers
components.description: Goroutine pool, woken by the API, the admin UI or by polling, that claims due deliveries, signs and POSTs them, records each attempt and schedules retries on the live retry schedule.

components.name: Retention runner
components.description: Started by serve: one minute after start, then hourly, deletes events older than HOOKD_RETENTION with their deliveries and attempts, in batches of 500.

components.name: Standard Webhooks signer
components.description: Builds webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 webhook-signature headers.

components.name: Store
components.description: One Store interface with a SQL implementation, a SQLite/PostgreSQL dialect layer and embedded migrations.

components.name: Config
components.description: Reads every HOOKD_* environment setting with local defaults and sets up logging.

components.name: IDs and secrets
components.description: Prefixed ULIDs, endpoint signing secrets and API key generation.

components.name: Deliveries queue
components.description: The deliveries table, one row per event and endpoint; workers claim rows whose next_attempt_at is due under a lease (SKIP LOCKED on PostgreSQL), and a waiting retry is a pending row with a later time.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Local database file via the pure Go driver; the default for development and tests.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.description: Production database holding accounts, API keys, endpoints, events, deliveries, attempts, settings and test receiver requests.

components.name: Test receiver
components.description: Dev-only HTTP receiver that verifies each webhook with the official library and answers a configured status.

components.name: Standard Webhooks Go library
components.description: Official verifier used by tests, the test receiver and the built-in test receiver to prove signatures are correct.

components.name: AWS CDK stack
components.description: CDK app that builds hookd on one EC2 box running hookd serve on SQLite behind nginx, with an Elastic IP and CloudWatch logs.
